notes.title: The return of royalty - King’s Bounty 2 has been announced!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952974/61aefb3ef7af1d59af04eaff111d0f794f20416e.png[/img]

The King is Back! We are happy to announce King's Bounty 2! Releasing in 2020 on PC, PS4 and Xbox One, King’s Bounty 2 will take you to the land of Antara, iterating on the classic turn-based tactics and RPG elements of the series.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1135300/Kings_Bounty_II/

Watch the announcement trailer here:
https://youtu.be/oshCt0-mhN8

Offering a fresh take on the acclaimed fantasy series, King’s Bounty 2 expands upon its tactical turn-based battles to offer players a truly immersive RPG experience. Weight is added to each move, from battles to developing relationships with the people players meet within the world of Antara. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952974/cec09637b8bcd3e69a38ac1fc0667f2c62d97d43.png[/img]

Taking up the mantle of one of three heroes - each with their own unique story - players embark on a non-linear, open-world adventure across a detailed and densely-packed fantasy landscape. Danger has arisen in the world, with a mysterious blight descending upon the far reaches of Antara, corrupting the land and people who reside in it. Refugees from the affected regions have begun to arrive in the kingdom of Nostria, putting food and resources in short supply. Once living souls, blight-distorted creatures now roam the countryside leaving chaos and destruction in their wake. Your actions have consequences as Antara slowly gets consumed in this great conflict. How will you forge this land’s future?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952974/a220e403fbbd2938ae9a47f828e491ae17ead854.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952974/faaa57ec43b1d10060214118b83d629e225810a6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 1C Releases a New Turn-Based Roguelike RPG - Deep Sky Derelicts
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3952977/8556f0144427622ac1598d9b07dd4729dbdebf94.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

this time we're not going to talk about King's Bounty, but instead we would like to inform you about a brand new roguelike turn-based RPG published by 1C Company that you may enjoy while waiting for another installment of King's Bounty. 

Deep Sky Derelicts is a game by a small team of passionate indie devs from Finland. It combines elements of XCOM, Darkest Dungeon and FTL: Faster Than Light, plus it throws in plenty of new ideas and gameplay elements into the mix, creating a highly playable RPG with eye-catching comic book art style, all set in sci-fi environment.

So feel free to check out Deep Sky Derelicts! Thanks, everyone - and we'll hopefully publish some news regarding King's Bounty in the near feature :)

http://store.steampowered.com/app/698640/Deep_Sky_Derelicts/

notes.title: Now Available - King's Bounty: Warriors of the North
notes.content:
King's Bounty: Warriors of the North is Now Available on Steam!

King’s Bounty: Warriors of the North is the next chapter in the cult RPG/adventure saga. The new tale takes place in the familiar world of Endoria featured in the previous games, but begins in the Viking lands, which the celebrated hero Bill Gilbert never visited during his famous quest in King’s Bounty: The Legend.

The Mighty Olaf, son of the Konung of Northlings, has dedicated his life to battling the undead who have infested the northern lands of Endoria. He seeks to liberate the snowy wastes, dwarven dungeons, and the very heart of Endoria, the kingdom of Darion itself, from the dark grip of necromancy. On his quest towards immortal glory he will encounter cunning foes and new friends, hard battles and amazing adventures.

notes.title: Indie Gala 7 now available
notes.content:
Another set of cheap indie games has been bundled up to help you through the summer slump. The seventh Indie Gala bundle is offering three games with a fourth to be unveiled later, along with even more bonus games for paying more than the rolling target average.

The three games in the bundle include Rig'n'Roll, Space Rangers, and Reign: Conflict of Nations. The fourth game is still under wraps, and will be announced in the second week of the sale. If you pay more than the average (currently around $6.90), you also snag Death to Spies, Death to Spies: Moment of Truth, King's Bounty: Armored Princess, and UFO: Afterlight, plus another game to be announced. All in all you could score nine games out of this deal.

Your funds can go towards the disabilities organization AbleGamers and the Italian Red Cross to assist with earthquake relief.

notes.title: King's Bounty is Now Available on Mac!
notes.content:
King's Bounty: The Legend and King's Bounty: Armored Princess are Now Available on Mac and 10% off*!

King's Bounty: The Legend is an adventure game with tactical turn-based battles and role-playing elements. In a fairy tale fantasy world of fearless knights, evil mages, wise kings and beautiful princesses the player controls a hero. Leading their character through the game world, exploring it, commanding armies in battle and accomplishing various quests can mean great reward or huge defeats.

King's Bounty: Armored Princess is a sequel to the critically acclaimed King’s Bounty: The Legend. Players will take on the role of Princess Amelie who travels around the world of Teana and searches for the renowned knight, and her mentor, Bill Gilbert. This new world of King’s Bounty: Armored Princess is full of mysteries and dangers. The new character, the Princess, will encounter horrible creatures, huge monstrous bosses and a new race, the bloodthirsty Lizards. As in the multi-award winning game on which this sequel is based, the player has many options to resist these new enemies. Various new skills and characteristics of Amelie as well as her chance to fly will help her overcome the hordes attacking the kingdom.

notes.title: King's Bounty Series Update Released
notes.content:
King's Bounty Titles are Now Available on Mac and PC in Several Languages
King's Bounty: The Legend and King's Bounty: Armored Princess are now available on Mac in six languages (English, Russian, German, French, Spanish and Italian).
Additional languages have been added to the PC versions of the games as well. King's Bounty: Armored Princess on PC is now available in six languages - English, Russian, German, French, Spanish and Italian, while its expansion King's Bounty: Crossworlds offers English, German and Russian. The games are now technically independent and can be installed separately, so if you played King’s Bounty: Crossworlds before, you can restore your savegames by copying them from 'My Games\Kings Bounty Princess' folder (located in your 'Documents' or 'My Documents') to 'My Games\Kings Bounty Crossworlds'.
